## Description

Rounds a number to the specified number of decimal places. Defaults to 0, which returns the nearest integer. If the precision is a negative number, rounds to the number of digits left of the decimal point. A value halfway between two results is rounded away from zero, so `2.5` rounds to `3` and `-2.5` to `-3`.
